agent_by_external_reference.description: Look up an agent by its on-chain external_reference. Uses the `Cis8` external-key shape (Ethereum, Solana, Cosmos, Fetch.ai). Returns the full agent record or null. Reads from chain — no indexer needed.

id.description: Unused; external references use the `key` shape.

identifier_text.description: Convenience: UTF-8 of identifier_hex. Either field accepted on input; identifier_hex wins if both supplied.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

agent_by_token_address.description: Look up an agent by its canonical CIS-2 token address (Base58Check, e.g. `4PKN5QqU26BVreYq9ZYa`). Parses the address into (contract, token_id), then queries the chain. Same result shape as `agent_of`.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

agent_history.description: Return every CIS-8004 + CIS-2 event for one token id, oldest first. Covers Registered, URIUpdated, ExternalReferenceSet, MetadataSet, Revoked, AgentWalletSet, Transfer (CIS-2). Requires the indexer.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

agent_of.description: Look up an agent by token id on the CIS-8004 Agent Registry. Returns the full agent record (token_address, owner_account, agent_uri, metadata_hash, external_reference, agent_wallet, status, timestamps), or null if no agent exists for the given token id. Reads directly from the chain — no indexer required.

token_id.description: Token id as a decimal string or integer (u64).

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

agent_registry_capabilities.description: Introspect the server: list the tools currently available on this binary, surface tools that aren't available with a reason (e.g. `list_agents` requires an indexer URL), and report which backends are wired in for the queried network. Use this before calling enumeration tools to see whether they'll work.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

agents_by_owner.description: Return every CIS-8004 agent currently owned by the given Base58 AccountAddress. Requires the sibling Agent Registry indexer.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_agent_badge.description: Add or upgrade the Concordium Badge on an EXISTING Agent Card without disturbing its other fields. Give it the card — either `card_json` (the served bytes as a string) or `card_url` (the service fetches it) — plus the owner account (and token_id once minted); it strips any legacy top-level `concordium` block, injects the current A2A extension badge into capabilities.extensions, refreshes the ERC-8004 registrations entry, and carries forward externalReference/services/agentWallet from a prior badge (contract refs re-encoded to CAIP-10). Returns the merged canonical JSON + its sha256. Host the returned JSON verbatim, then pin the new hash with build_set_agent_uri. Use build_agent_card for a brand-new card, or get_badge_json when you only want the badge block to paste yourself.

card_json.description: The Agent Card JSON the agent currently serves (the bytes at agent_uri), as a string. Either this or card_url.

card_url.description: Alternative to card_json: the URL the card is served at (usually the agent_uri). The service fetches it (HTTP 200 required) and uses the served bytes.

owner_account.description: Base58 Concordium account that owns the agent NFT.

token_id.description: On-chain token_id (decimal). When set, the badge carries the canonical tokenAddress + a registrations entry. Leave null pre-mint.

agent_wallet.description: Optional payment wallet override. Defaults to the prior badge's agentWallet, else owner_account.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_agent_card.description: Compose a complete A2A AgentCard JSON with a Concordium extension block, given human-shaped identity input. The tool injects every on-chain identifier (CAIP-2 chain id, token_address, contract refs) that a human can't reliably hand-write, and returns the canonical JSON plus its sha256. Use this from a conversation: collect name, description, skills, owner_account, optional token_id from the user, call this tool, then hand the resulting JSON to the user to host at `agent_uri` and the resulting hash to `build_set_agent_uri` to pin on-chain.

agent_uri.description: Public URL where the card JSON will be hosted. Echoed into `url` and used as the hashing identity.

owner_account.description: Base58 Concordium account that owns / will own the agent NFT.

agent_wallet.description: Optional separate wallet for routing payments. Defaults to owner_account.

token_id.description: If known, the on-chain token_id (decimal). When set, the tool computes the canonical token_address. Leave null pre-mint.

external_reference.description: Optional external-key binding. Shape: { kind: 'Cis8', namespace, identifier } where identifier is the human-readable handle.

services.description: Free-form key/value map of service endpoints surfaced under concordium.services (e.g. { tippingMcp: 'https://...' }).

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_cis8_canonical_bytes.description: Return the exact canonical bytes the external key MUST sign for `build_cis8_register`. The bytes are scheme-agnostic — the caller's signer wraps them per the proof scheme (e.g. ethereum-personal-sign prepends `\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n<len>` before keccak256). Pure off-chain — no RPC.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_cis8_register.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8 `registerExternalKey` payload. Records the binding between the signer's Concordium account and the named external key. Requires a cryptographic proof — use `build_cis8_canonical_bytes` to get the exact bytes for the external key to sign before calling this.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_cis8_revoke.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8 `revoke` payload. Owner-only: caller must be the current active owner of the registration. Sets status to Revoked; the entry stays on chain for audit but isn't returned by owner_of_key as active.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_cis8_update_metadata.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8 `updateMetadata` payload. Replaces metadata on an existing active CIS-8 registration. Caller must be the current owner of the registration or the contract rejects.

identifier.description: The ExternalKeyId of the registration to update.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_register.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8004 `register` payload, which mints a new agent NFT to the signer. All fields except `sender` are optional. Pass `agent_uri` + `metadata_hash_hex` upfront if you've already materialised the agent card. The Cis10 external_reference variant currently rejects on the live DevNet/TestNet deployments — see the tool's source for details.

external_reference.description: Optional ExternalReference — see agent_by_external_reference for shape.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_revoke.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8004 `revoke` payload. Marks the agent as Revoked, clears its external_reference, and resets agent_wallet to None. NFT is NOT burned — the token still exists, just status=Revoked.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_set_agent_uri.description: Build a sign-ready `setAgentURI` payload. Returns both wire-hex and schema-typed JSON of the parameter. The caller's wallet signs + submits; this MCP holds no keys. Pass `agent_uri: null` (omit) to leave the URI unchanged, same for `metadata_hash_hex`. This is how a new card hash gets pinned after adding a badge (see get_badge_json). REST twin (keyed on the badge): GET /v1/build-set-agent-uri/{token_address}?metadata_hash_hex=&agent_uri=&sender=.

metadata_hash_hex.description: SHA-256 (64 hex chars) of the card bytes served at agent_uri.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_set_agent_wallet.description: Build a sign-ready `setAgentWallet` payload. Requires the new wallet's signature over the 122-byte canonical message — get those bytes via `set_agent_wallet_canonical_bytes`, have the new wallet sign them, then pass the signature hex here. Two authorisations required (owner signs the TX, new wallet's controller signs the message); both must be valid or the contract rejects.

new_wallet.description: Base58 AccountAddress to route payments to.

deadline_unix_ms.description: Unix ms; contract rejects after this.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_set_external_reference.description: Build a sign-ready `setExternalReference` payload. Pass `external_reference: null` to clear; pass a `{contract_address, kind, key|id}` object to set. Same Cis10-rejection caveat as `build_register`.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_set_external_registries.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8004 `setExternalRegistries` payload. ADMIN-ONLY. Updates BOTH the linked CIS-8 contract address and the linked CIS-10 contract address atomically. Use after a CIS-8 or CIS-10 redeploy to point the agent registry at the new instance(s). Both addresses are required — pass the current value for whichever side you don't want to change.

cis8_contract.description: New CIS-8 (External Key Registry) contract address.

cis10_contract.description: New CIS-10 (External Identifier Registry) contract address.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_set_metadata.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8004 `setMetadata` payload. Writes one on-chain metadata key/value for the agent. The reserved key `agentWallet` is rejected by the contract; use `build_set_agent_wallet` for that with cryptographic proof.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_transfer.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-2 `transfer` payload for an agent NFT. CIS-8004's transfer hook ALSO clears `external_reference` and resets `agent_wallet` to None — the new owner has to re-run `build_set_external_reference` and `build_set_agent_wallet` after.

data_hex.description: Optional bytes passed through to a contract recipient; usually empty.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_transfer_admin.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8004 `transferAdmin` payload. ADMIN-ONLY. Pass `new_admin: null` to RENOUNCE the admin role — this is IRREVERSIBLE and permanently locks the contract against future upgrades. Use deliberately.

new_admin.description: Base58 AccountAddress to hand admin to. null = renounce.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_update_operator.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-2 `updateOperator` payload. Add or remove an operator for the agent NFT. Pass an array of `{op, operator}` entries; `op` is `"add"` or `"remove"`; `operator` is a Base58 account or a `"contract:<idx>,<sub>"` reference.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

build_upgrade.description: Build a sign-ready CIS-8004 `upgrade` payload. ADMIN-ONLY — the contract rejects callers other than the current admin (CIS-8004 v1.1 §7.x). Swaps the contract's module reference to `new_module_ref` and, optionally, invokes a migration entrypoint on `self` after the swap.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

check_account_badges.description: Validate the Concordium Badge on every CIS-8004 agent owned by an account. Lists the account's agents (indexer-required), fetches each agent's card, and checks the card's `concordium` block is well-formed and matches the on-chain record: owner, Active status, contracts, chain (CAIP-2), token address, and the SHA-256 metadata hash. Returns a per-agent verdict plus a valid/invalid summary. Others can call this to check their own cards. Account-only alias of check_badge (which also takes a single badge token address). REST twin: GET /v1/check-badge/{account} (alias: /v1/badge-check/{account}).

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

check_badge.description: Check a Concordium Badge. `id` is a badge token address (→ the verdict for that one badge: on-chain record, card fetch + SHA-256 match, badge well-formedness, extension-form conformance, verification block) or a Concordium account (→ every badge the account owns). The network is resolved from the badge; pass `network` only to override. Same engine as check_account_badges. REST twin: GET /v1/check-badge/{id} (alias: /v1/badge-check/{id}).

id.description: Badge token address (base58) or Concordium account address (base58).

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

contract_info.description: Snapshot of the CIS-8004 + CIS-8 deployments for a network: addresses, module references, admin accounts, and the standards each contract advertises via CIS-0. Useful for confirming you're talking to the expected instance before any other lookup.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

get_agent_wallet.description: Return the agent's current payment-routing wallet address (CIS-8004 `getAgentWallet`). Returns null when unset — which is the post-transfer state until the new owner re-runs `setAgentWallet`.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

get_badge_json.description: Here is the badge → here is the JSON. Given only a Concordium Badge (the base58 CIS-2 token address), resolve the agent on chain and return the exact A2A extension object to paste into the Agent Card's capabilities.extensions, plus the ERC-8004 registrations entry and next_steps (host → hash the served bytes → pin with build_set_agent_uri → confirm with check_badge). The network is resolved from the badge itself; pass `network` only to override. Refuses revoked agents. REST twin: GET /v1/get-badge-JSON/{token_address}.

token_address.description: Base58Check CIS-2 token address — the badge string (e.g. Mf22tDVkPKjbJDCFK4W73).

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

get_metadata.description: Read an on-chain metadata key for an agent. Returns the value as both hex and (when valid UTF-8) text. Null if the key isn't set. The reserved key `agentWallet` returns the current payment wallet — prefer `get_agent_wallet` for that lookup since it returns a clean address.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

is_active.description: Is the agent at `token_id` currently Active? Returns `{active: bool, status: "Active"|"Revoked"|null, exists: bool}`. Convenience for `agent_of` callers that only need the status flag.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

list_agents.description: List every registered agent on the chosen network. Paginated. Filterable by status (Active / Revoked) and owner_account. Requires the sibling Agent Registry indexer to be reachable at MCP_INDEXER_URL (or the per-network override); returns an error otherwise.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

network_status.description: Health-check a Concordium network. Returns the gRPC endpoint, latest finalised block height + hash, and (when an indexer URL is configured) the indexer's sync state and lag in blocks.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

owner_of_key.description: CIS-8 lookup: return the current `Registration` for an external cryptographic key, or null if no active binding exists. Supported key types include `secp256k1-uncompressed` (Ethereum / EVM L2), `secp256k1-compressed` (Cosmos / Fetch.ai accounts), and `ed25519` (Solana / Fetch.ai uagent).

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

parse_token_address.description: Parse a Base58Check Concordium CIS-2 token address into its component fields: contract index, subindex, raw token id bytes, and (when the token id is 8 bytes) the decoded u64 form CIS-8004 entrypoints expect. Pure off-chain encoding — no chain round-trip.

recent_registrations.description: Return the most recent CIS-8004 `Registered` events, newest first. Useful for surfacing fresh agents to discover. Requires the indexer.

since_block.description: Optional: only events at this block height or later.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

recent_transfers.description: Return the most recent CIS-2 `Transfer` events on the CIS-8004 agent NFT contract, newest first. Useful for surfacing recent ownership changes. Requires the indexer.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

search_agents.description: Substring-match against agent_uri + decimal token_id text. Returns matching agents (same shape as list_agents). Requires the indexer.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

set_agent_wallet_canonical_bytes.description: Return the exact 122-byte canonical message the new_wallet's controller MUST sign for `build_set_agent_wallet`. Layout: "CIS-8004/v1/setAgentWallet" (26) + token_id u64 LE (8) + new_wallet AccountAddress (32) + deadline u64 LE (8) + contract_address (16) + genesis_hash (32). Pure off-chain — no RPC.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

token_address.description: Compute the canonical Concordium CIS-2 token address (Base58Check) for a given `(contract_index, contract_subindex, token_id)` triple. Pure off-chain encoding — no chain round-trip required.

verify_agent_card.description: Verify an agent's off-chain card against its on-chain SHA-256 anchor. Fetches `agent_uri` (when `fetch=true`, default), hashes the response body, and compares against the on-chain `metadata_hash`. Returns `match=true` when both are present and equal, `false` on mismatch, `null` when either side is missing (e.g. agent has no agent_uri yet, or fetch was skipped). REST twin (keyed on the badge, not token_id): GET /v1/verify-agent-card/{token_address}.

fetch.description: Fetch agent_uri and recompute the hash. Default true.

network.description: Configured network id; defaults to the server default when omitted.

next_steps: 1. Put `extension` into capabilities.extensions of your Agent Card, replacing any existing https://docs.concordium.com/a2a-extensions/concordium-badge/v1 entry; delete any top-level `concordium` block.
2. Optionally add `registrations_entry` to the top-level `registrations` array (ERC-8004 discoverability).
3. Host the card at agent_uri, then hash the SERVED bytes: curl -s <agent_uri> | sha256sum

Pin the hash on chain: build_set_agent_uri { network, token_id, metadata_hash_hex, sender } (REST: GET /v1/build-set-agent-uri/<badge>?metadata_hash_hex=...) → sign with the owner wallet → submit (gasless via the sponsor service).
